title: Hydrocodone
lyrics:
[00:16.48]I'm sitting in my room
[00:23.69]I'm all alone now
[00:27.44]Missing you every single day
[00:35.49]I wish you would say
[00:39.63]Baby I love you till I die
[00:46.41]But my hopes are gone
[00:49.02]The tainted paint that's on the wall
[00:56.40]Crumbles and corrodes
[01:00.32]Rumbling softly as it hits the floor
[01:06.05]It's time to say goodbye
[01:11.61]You said this would never end
[01:16.34]Guess you played pretend but it's alright
[01:22.11]I know I wasn't good enough
[01:28.18]I showed you where it hurts
[01:32.38]And for what it's worth you made it worse
[01:38.14]There's always someone better
[01:44.24]I hope you find that guy
[01:48.02]To make you happy and meanwhile
[01:52.50]I'm sitting in my room
[01:59.82]I'm all alone now
[02:03.43]Missing you every single day
[02:11.34]I wish you would say
[02:15.66]Baby I love you till I die
[02:22.43]But my hopes are gone
